review_requests_reviewed.name: review_requests_reviewed
review_requests_reviewed.value: ("review_requests"."state" = 'reviewed') = ("review_requests"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "review_requests"."reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL)

run_counts_digits.name: run_counts_digits
run_counts_digits.value: typeof("run_counts"."value") = 'text' AND length("run_counts"."value") BETWEEN 1 AND 30 AND "run_counts"."value" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'

sources_range_start.name: sources_range_start
sources_range_start.value: "sources"."doc_date_end" IS NULL OR "sources"."doc_date" IS NOT NULL
